findings.problem: In a fresh clone `cd packages/gxg-connector-kit && uv run mutmut run` fails with 'Failed to spawn: mutmut': mutmut is a root dev dependency and `uv run` in a workspace member syncs only the member. Works only after a root `uv sync`. The report claims it was checked as one command in a clean clone
findings.required_improvement: Document the real command (`uv sync && cd packages/gxg-connector-kit && uv run mutmut run`) in README, [tool.mutmut] comment and report

findings.problem: Plan says no tool gives per-module branch-only thresholds; coverage-threshold (PyPI 0.6.2) reads coverage.json and has file_branch_coverage_min per path ([tool.coverage-threshold.modules]). Not considered. 75 lines of own code
findings.required_improvement: Replace with coverage-threshold config for the six modules, or record in the plan why it does not fit

findings.problem: State file is renamed into place without fsync. After a power loss the file can be empty; at start json.loads('') fails and the service does not start (by design); recovery = deleting the file, which drops the rollback guard
OSError on the state write (disk full, read-only volume) escapes load() as a non-BundleError; readiness keeps the previous or 'not loaded' reason. Still fail closed
findings.required_improvement: Map OSError on the write to BundleError with a clear _last_error; one test
